coverage.note: Seeded from the RFC 0002 observed-evidence table, the first geometry extraction candidate, and the extracted strict geometry module (now the world.map-geometry library, public/mapgeometry and mapgeometry, R08-LIBS). filesClassified counts authored records, which now include new strict-module files in addition to legacy hammer/ files. Exhaustive per-file/per-symbol classification is the H0 exit condition and is tracked as HAM-INVENTORY-001; validator enforces full coverage only when status is 'complete'. 2026-10-03 (R08-REPLACE-TEXTURES, HAM-REPLACETEX-001): 22 reviewed records for the files that slice read or changed, and the authored totals refreshed to the live universe that 'archlint hammer --coverage' measures (hammer/ plus the strict roots). 2026-10-09: every file of that universe now has a record (682 of 682). 622 of them were classified from grep-level reads of each file by a scripted review (evidence downgraded to 'hypothesis' after a blind second review of 80 sampled files agreed on all of responsibility, destination and factorization for only 27 of 80); status stays 'partial' until the records are reviewed and the migration records and legacy build evidence for R08 are complete.
